These Guys Are The Spiritual Successors To The Old Manufacturing Giants. Based In The Ruined Steel Mills Of Youngstown And Cleveland, They Live In The Skeletal Remains Of Factories. Their Culture Is Built On Traditionalist Values And Survivalist Farming. They Operate Out Of Massive, Fortified Silos And Grain Elevators. Think "Agrarian Gothic." Their Culture Is One Of Trade, Tolls, And High-Stakes Negotiation. Visually, This Is All About Motion. I Want To See Long, Sweeping Drone Shots Of Their Endless Caravan Moving Through The Desolate Highways. We’d Use Practical Smoke Machines To Create A Constant Trail Of Exhaust, Making Their Presence Feel Like A Moving City.

Nestled Along The Shores Of Lake Erie, These People Have Managed To Salvage Significant Amounts Of Pre-War Tech. They Are The "Smart" Survivors.
